<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE IPO details:</strong> The National Stock Exchange has set its IPO price band at ₹1,700–₹1,785 per share, with the issue scheduled to open for subscription on September 17.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOTjhIUzk2VXF5NVhHQTU4ckdaQ1VwUWtadjNSdjBOa2JyckEtUjlyMnl0Tkp5WjZlNmV1RzJTSnZJVTB3Tl9hX0ZTeUVQTVU5emZ4UTJ5aWpwckZneGtLNjV4YThWOFlCeGs3VWNXbDhWSE1EeUxxcGRFWnNrLUprY3pZdlJzalVZWXdSMWRJTkFUSkdPWU1tS2kxVE0tNFVsSEdhTGJubw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market correction:</strong> Indian benchmark indices, Sensex and Nifty, declined by approximately 1% as investors engaged in profit-booking amid the surge in crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I45</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil and bond yields:</strong> Brent crude prices climbed above $108 per barrel, fueling inflation fears and pushing India’s 10-year bond yield above the 7% threshold.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Global sentiment:</strong> Weak global cues and rising US Treasury yields contributed to a negative start for Indian markets, with the GIFT Nifty signaling a gap-down opening earlier in the session.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQa1RYaTVkUzhicjNLSmdJSVJsNDVBeWZPNENhMk1KNGItRlJsSUx4eW9zeFoySHFaRGxFcjNmLVJnaUpQSGVENTJDcmRSUG5JbzVncVFBS0k1SUtBQl9xQS1YQ1hUZW5JRFVBZWZnY1RFRnlaRnJsRWQwVFNKSjlxRDhrb0h4SmZabG51cTRCRnhBTWFrZThKSzFVTkxia1gtOUlnSUtVbjhwNnNWM09sTTRXTV9MdmM0M1ZCN0ZWd0pNdm_SAcMBQVVfeXFMUGtUWGk1ZFM4YnIzS0pnSUlSbDQ1QXlmTzRDYTJNSjRiLUZSbElMeHlvc3haMkhxWkRsRXIzZi1SZ2lKUEhlRDUyQ3JkUlBuSW81Z3FRQUtJNUlLQUJfcUEtWENYVGVuSURVQWVmZ2NURUZ5WkZybEVkMFRTSko5cUQ4a29IeEpmWmxudXE0QkZ4QU1ha2U4SksxVU5MYmtYLTlJZ0lLVW44cDZzVjNPbE00V01fTHZjNDNWQjdGVndKTXZv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W25</a></span></li>
